summary.text: Liz Bennett is a Democratic Iowa state senator who has represented District 39 since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A consultant, she previously served in the Iowa House of Representatives from 2015 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Liz Bennett earned an A.A. in liberal arts from Kirkwood Community College in 2007 and a B.A. in politics and women's studies from Cornell College in 2010.
Her career experience includes working as a website expert with Wix, an Internet sales and support consultant with Go Daddy, and a regional organizer with One Iowa.
She has been affiliated with the Iowa Governor's STEM Advisory Council, the Kirkwood Community College Liberal Arts Advisory Committee, Cedar Rapids AniMeals and German Shepherd Dog Rescue of Iowa.
Bennett represented District 65 in the Iowa House of Representatives from 2015 to 2023 and assumed office in the Iowa State Senate on January 3, 2023.
